title: Neutrophil extracellular traps drive tubulointerstitial fibrosis via the coiled-coil domain-containing protein 25 (CCDC25)-Yes-associated protein 1 (YAP1) axis-mediated autophagy regulation.
authors: Hu, Xinhui; Ni, Weijie; Liu, Haifei; Li, Zuolin; Wang, Jing; Lu, Yuan; Wang, Bin; Liu, Hong; Cao, Jingyuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中性粒细胞胞外陷阱通过CCDC25-YAP1轴调控自噬驱动肾小管间质纤维化，属于肾脏病理机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Tubulointerstitial fibrosis (TIF) is a pathological hallmark of chronic kidney disease (CKD) without effective therapy. Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) are complex web-like structures released by activated neutrophils, but their functional contribution to CKD-TIF remains largely unknown. Here, we uncovered a novel pathological role of NETs in driving TIF development. EXPERIMENTAL APPROACH: NETs levels were evaluated in human kidney biopsies and serum samples. Peptidylarginine deiminase 4 (PAD4) knockout mice were subjected to unilateral ureteral obstruction and adenine-induced nephropathy models. The underlying mechanisms were elucidated by RNA sequencing, transmission electron microscopy, molecular docking and co-immunoprecipitation. The PAD4 inhibitor GSK484 was administered to evaluate the role of NETs in TIF. KEY RESULTS: NETs markedly accumulated in kidneys of CKD patients and murine models, positively correlating with renal dysfunction and fibrosis progression. PAD4 knockout suppressed NETs formation and attenuated TIF. Mechanistically, transcriptomic analyses displayed pronounced activation of autophagy-related pathways in NETs-stimulated fibroblasts, whereas autophagy inhibition suppressed fibroblast activation. NETs components interacted with the transmembrane receptor coiled-coil domain-containing protein 25 (CCDC25), triggering dissociation of Yes-associated protein 1 (YAP1) from its receptor. This molecular rearrangement facilitates YAP1 nuclear translocation, subsequently enhancing autophagic activity in fibroblasts and promoting their phenotypic transition into myofibroblasts. Therapeutic administration of the PAD4 inhibitor GSK484 significantly attenuated renal fibrosis in vivo. CONCLUSIONS AND IMPLICATIONS: Our study provides the first evidence that NETs exacerbate CKD-TIF by enhancing fibroblast autophagy via the CCDC25-YAP1 axis, highlighting the NETs inhibitor GSK484 as a promising therapeutic candidate.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：肾小管间质纤维化（TIF）是慢性肾脏病（CKD）的病理标志，目前缺乏有效治疗手段。中性粒细胞胞外诱捕网（NETs）是由活化中性粒细胞释放的复杂网状结构，但其在CKD-TIF中的功能贡献仍 largely 未知。本研究揭示了NETs在驱动TIF发展中的新型病理作用。实验方法：评估了人类肾活检组织和血清样本中的NETs水平。对肽基精氨酸脱亚氨酶4（PAD4）基因敲除小鼠进行了单侧输尿管梗阻和腺嘌呤诱导肾病模型。通过RNA测序、透射电子显微镜、分子对接和免疫共沉淀阐明了潜在机制。给予PAD4抑制剂GSK484以评估NETs在TIF中的作用。关键结果：NETs在CKD患者和小鼠模型的肾脏中显著积累，与肾功能障碍和纤维化进展呈正相关。PAD4敲除抑制了NETs形成并减轻了TIF。机制上，转录组学分析显示NETs刺激的成纤维细胞中自噬相关通路显著激活，而自噬抑制则抑制了成纤维细胞活化。NETs组分与跨膜受体卷曲螺旋结构域蛋白25（CCDC25）相互作用，触发Yes相关蛋白1（YAP1）从其受体上解离。这种分子重排促进YAP1核转位，随后增强成纤维细胞的自噬活性并促进其向肌成纤维细胞表型转化。PAD4抑制剂GSK484的治疗性给药在体内显著减轻了肾纤维化。结论与意义：本研究首次提供证据表明NETs通过CCDC25-YAP1轴增强成纤维细胞自噬从而加剧CKD-TIF，突出NETs抑制剂GSK484作为有前景的治疗候选药物。
